passed_checks.check_name: Ensure KMS key policy does not contain wildcard (*) principal
code_block:
DatabaseBackupKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting database backups in ${Environment}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      MultiRegion: false
      PendingWindowInDays: !Ref PendingWindowInDays
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: database-backup-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

          - Sid: AllowKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Create*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Enable*
              - kms:List*
              - kms:Put*
              - kms:Update*
              - kms:Revoke*
              - kms:Disable*
              - kms:Get*
              - kms:Delete*
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:PrincipalType': 'User'

          - Sid: AllowAWSServicesToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - rds.amazonaws.com
                - backup.amazonaws.com
                - s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId

          - Sid: DenyKeyDeletionWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DisableKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'false'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-database-backup-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: DatabaseBackupEncryption
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: RotationEnabled
          Value: 'true'
